note: marquee picks locked and text items
marquee uses the bare outline instead of the stroke inclusive world bounds
anchor: guard let box = item.worldBounds, box.meets(area) else { continue }
replacement: guard let box = item.outline.transformed(by: item.matrix).bounds, box.meets(area) else { continue }

note: marquee accepts a zero area rect
anchor: guard area.maxX - area.minX > 0, area.maxY - area.minY > 0 else { return [] }

note: marquee accepts a non finite rect
anchor: guard [rect.minX, rect.minY, rect.maxX, rect.maxY].allSatisfy(\.isFinite) else { return [] }
